other_conditions: Applicant must be an Indian student studying at a recognized university in India
Must have secured at least 60% marks in the last degree or certificate examination

Must be pursuing one of the specified programmes: B.E/B.Tech/M.E/M.Tech in Computer Science & Engineering, Computer Science, IT, Electronics & Communications, Electronics, Electrical; M.Sc. in CS/IT/Electronics/Electrical; MCA; DOEACC ‘B’ level; L.L.B.; Bachelor’s in Economics and Statistics
Students in the last semester or who will graduate in summer 2025 are not eligible; only students who are in the previous one year of study are eligible
benefits_summary: A token stipend of ₹10,000 per month, subject to satisfactory performance, and a certificate upon successful completion of the internship.
documents_required: Recommendation letter from the sponsoring institute
